summary: Fixed all 11 findings inside the owned paths (not committed, per the worker instructions). (1) Throw chord window: rules.throwChordFrames = 2. A light or heavy that a free fighter started becomes the throw when the partner button arrives within 2 frames, before the first active frame. The throw keeps the frames already spent, so J/K at 0, 1 or 2 frames apart all grab on frame 13, and a lone jab is still 7 frames. The validator rejects a window that reaches any light or heavy startup. (2) A throw is cancelled only by a strike contact (hit or block) on that frame; strikeActive was removed. (3) separate() breaks an exact tie by start-of-frame x, then velocity, then facing, and a full tie stays put; a new mirrored symmetry test covers it and fails on the old rule. (4) movesetVersion(moveset) is the data's FNV-1a-64 canonical hash (equal to hashState, memoised per object). MOVESET_VERSION = 248675b2a680c2c7, and the hand-written version field was removed from DuelMoveset. (5) restoreDuel validates every field (exact keys, types, integer ranges, known actions and move ids, events, result, attack/moveId and over/result consistency). (6) The Duel* types are z.infer of their schemas, the timing is narrowed by a transform over moveTimingSchema, and a typed both() helper replaces the three Pair casts. (7) The symmetry test asserts the frame-28 jab trade. (8, 10) docs/duel.md covers the chord window and counter-slash invulnerability, and the opening-hit check adds advance * (startup + active). (9, 11) A guard break adds 30 stamina, capped, with tests for the cap and for regeneration timing. Determinism fixture: the one-input change is now a first-frame thrust, because the re-timed log absorbs the old first-frame dash by frame 2069 (pushbox pinning in the corner); the version pin was updated. Checks run here, all exit 0: npm ci; npm run typecheck; npm run test:unit (222 passed); npm run test:integration (14 passed); npm run build (both postbuild self-checks and the build smoke passed).
open_assumptions: A converted throw keeps the light or heavy's elapsed frames, so it is active when a simultaneous J+K would be. It does not restart its 12-frame startup from the second press.
DuelMoveset no longer has a version field. Consumers (duel-online) use movesetVersion(moveset) or state.movesetVersion.
movesetVersion memoises by object identity (a WeakMap), which assumes moveset objects are never mutated in place. A changed moveset must be a new object.
Fighters that tie on x, start-of-frame x, velocity and facing are left overlapping for that frame, because no rule that ignores the slot can pick a side for them.
